entities.name: UniProt B8F891 FtsP
observations: Exact sequence match (469 aa) to reviewed Glaesserella parasuis FtsP; annotated as a cell-division protein required for growth under stress and possibly stabilizing/protecting the divisome.

Reference annotation: Tat-type signal peptide at residues 1–27; periplasmic and division-septum localization; linked GO terms include FtsZ-dependent cytokinesis and copper-ion binding (annotation evidence ECO:0000501).
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 53.35 kDa; theoretical pI 9.05; GRAVY −0.342. No explicit catalytic reaction retrieved.
